poses.caption: Lean back with a straight body and extended arms holding suspension handles
Bend elbows and draw chest toward handles, keeping heels planted

jobs.detail: INVERTED ROW WITH STRAPS. Side-rear three-quarter view makes the upper BACK visible, head toward IMAGE LEFT, heels IMAGE RIGHT. Complete suspension trainer rig: two dark webbing straps attached securely to overhead horizontal bar on sturdy freestanding frame. Each taut strap ends in ONE handle grasped by ONE hand with closed overhand grip; both handles near each other just wider than shoulders, palms face downward at initial reach. Model leans backward with legs extended, feet hip-width, heels planted on floor, straight diagonal head-shoulder-hip-heel line. LEFT arms fully extended in front/up toward overhead anchor, torso leaning back, shoulder blades neutral. RIGHT flex BOTH elbows to bring handles beside lower chest, elbows pass torso, shoulder blades retract, rigid body pivots forward/up around SAME planted heels. Strap length fixed across panels; anchor and rig unmoving; endpoints/handle positions follow correct constant-length arc. No cable machine or bench. Red PRIMARY upper back between shoulder blades as diffuse print on opaque upper-back shirt; biceps/forearms gray. Show whole overhead anchor, frame feet, straps, hands and heels.
jobs.prompt: Correct this original two-panel suspension-row illustration while preserving its adult male identity, detailed grayscale exposed anatomy, fully opaque black shirt and knee-length shorts, upper-back diffuse red tint and white background. TWO CHANGES: 1) Zoom each WHOLE scene out by 20 percent so full freestanding rig including top corners and ALL feet are visible with generous white margins. 2) Correct row mechanics: strap hardware and LENGTH must be IDENTICAL between left/right panels, no buckle extension. LEFT shows straight arms and rigid torso leaning back. RIGHT shows the body rotating forward/up TOWARD overhead anchor around the SAME planted heels; shoulders move noticeably UP and toward the anchor, torso angle becomes steeper, elbows bend so handles touch sides of chest, scapulae retract. Reposition torso/arms rather than lengthening straps to reach handles. Each taut strap connects anchor to one securely grasped handle along same constant-length arc. Keep legs straight, no hip sag, no changing feet or anchor position, no slack straps. Render whole rig at same position/scale in both panels. Full opaque fabric wrapping front/sides/back/seat/crotch without anatomy windows, red only on upper-back cloth. No text.

jobs.detail: JACK KNIFE FLOOR, bodyweight abdominal exercise. Same strict SIDE view both panels; head at IMAGE LEFT, feet IMAGE RIGHT. Fully visible thin gray exercise mat. LEFT lie flat SUPINE back/head supported, straight legs together extending right and arms straight overhead extending left, entire body and hands inside margin. RIGHT simultaneous V-up: balance on pelvis/sacrum, lift shoulders/upper back and both straight legs off mat toward each other, hinge/curl torso into diagonal upward-left and legs diagonal upward-right making a clear V; BOTH straight arms reach forward/up toward toes. Knees soft nearly straight, legs paired, neck neutral, hands near toes without requiring contact. No bent-knee crunch or shoulderstand, no neck load. Whole mat visible. Red PRIMARY abdomen only a very soft blurred red tint printed on intact black shirt, NO outlined abdominal divisions, no bellybutton; all exposed limbs gray. Shorts wrap seat/crotch, closed loose knee-length hems even when legs lifted.
